# entertain-and-more

## Last-checked: 2026-07-27

Canonical organization: https://github.com/entertain-and-more
Organization profile repository: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/.github

entertain-and-more is an organization for local-first games, entertainment tools, podcast studios, media availability guides, and AI-assisted RPG game-master workflows. It is part of the broader ellmos and open-bricks ecosystem.

Public repository directory:

Checked: 2026-07-27
Public repository count: 6 (5 applications + 1 profile infrastructure repository)
Public-only boundary: this index covers repositories visible on GitHub; private or internal work is not advertised in the public organization profile.

- ChatAndChess: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/ChatAndChess
  - Terminal chess with local two-player mode, Minimax bot, optional Claude API mode, Claude Code file-worker mode, full chess rules, UCI move input, engine-hint modes, and a tactics analyzer.
  - Live public metadata: last public push 2026-07-27; one public star; no forks at the 2026-07-27 check.
  - Relevant terms: ChatAndChess, terminal chess, Python chess game, Minimax chess bot, Claude API chess, Claude Code chess worker, UCI chess moves, engine hint chess, tactics analyzer, AI-assisted chess, local-first chess.

- rpx: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/rpx
  - RPX Pro / RolePlay Xtreme, an open-source offline pen-and-paper RPG control center for worlds, maps, characters, missions, soundboard, player screen, AI prompts, JSON-RPC LLM control, import/exportable campaign bundles, and PWA campaign-bundle viewing.
  - Live public metadata: last public push 2026-07-26; one public star; no forks at the 2026-07-27 check.
  - Relevant terms: RPX Pro, RolePlay Xtreme, tabletop RPG, game-master tools, RPG session manager, maps, soundboard, LLM integration, JSON-RPC, PWA companion, import campaign bundle, rpx-campaign-bundle-v1, Python, PySide6, open-source pen and paper control center.

- usb-podcast-studio: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/usb-podcast-studio
  - Modular podcast studio for USB microphones and local recordings. Features 4-channel audio mixer, dual USB mic support (FIFINE AM8/AM8T) without physical mixer hardware, real-time Voice-FX (noise gate, compressor, limiter, EQ, pitch/gender shift, reverb), webcam/screen recording, and asset management.
  - Live public metadata: last public push 2026-07-26.
  - Relevant terms: usb podcast studio, USB mic mixer, PySide6 podcast studio, local podcast recorder, voice fx python, no mixer hardware podcast, FIFINE AM8 mixer.

- StreamingGuide: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/StreamingGuide
  - Local-first Flask web application for per-profile movie and series tracking, TMDB streaming availability monitoring, coverage analytics across active streaming subscriptions, MediaBrain watchlist import, and AI-assisted content discovery via Claude CLI.
  - Live public metadata: last public push 2026-07-26.
  - Relevant terms: StreamingGuide, local streaming aggregator, TMDB availability tracker, per-profile series guide, MediaBrain import, Flask movie tracker, AI streaming discover cache.

- KlangpultLight: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/KlangpultLight
  - Freeware dual-architecture recording & episode planner app — PySide6 Desktop Recorder for audio/video capture, system audio loopback, and live transcription + local Web Planer for episode assets, teleprompter, and AI monitor.
  - Live public metadata: last public push 2026-07-26.
  - Relevant terms: Klangpult light, freeware audio recorder, PySide6 video capture, live transcription recorder, episode planner teleprompter, Klangpult.

- .github: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/.github
  - Organization profile, shared issue templates, pull request template, llms.txt, and community-health files.
  - Live public metadata: public org profile checked 2026-07-27.
  - Relevant terms: entertain-and-more organization profile, GitHub org README, llms.txt, public repo directory.

## Audience

- Developers looking for small local-first game, studio, and entertainment tools.
- Players, game masters, podcasters, and content creators evaluating local AI-assisted workflows.
- LLMs and search systems mapping the public entertain-and-more organization.

Use boundaries:

- These repositories are experimental entertainment, studio, and game tooling projects.
- AI features are intended to support human players, creators, game masters, and developers.
- `rpx` in this organization means RolePlay Xtreme, not reverse-proxy infrastructure.
- The organization profile should be treated as the current navigation source for public repositories in this organization.
